name: COLFORM
recent: COLFORM 最近宣布以约 RM25.2 million 现金收购一块位于 Pulau Indah 工业园的 99 年租赁工业地，并已派发首次中期股息每股 1.3 仙。公司也发布了最新季度业绩。
notable: 宣布首次中期单层股息每股 1.3 仙。

recent_en: COLFORM recently announced the proposed acquisition of a 99-year leasehold industrial land in Pulau Indah Industrial Park for approximately RM25.2 million in cash, and paid a first interim dividend of 1.3 sen per share. The company also released its latest quarterly results.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of a 99-year leasehold industrial land for approximately RM25.2 million in cash.
Declared a first interim single-tier dividend of 1.3 sen per share.
